title: VeriTouch: Verified Visuo-Tactile World Models that Improve Robot Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling visuo-tactile policy learning is constrained by the high cost of real-world data collection and the difficulty of building realistic simulations. Generative models offer a scalable source of training data, yet useful demonstrations require plausible tactile feedback, temporal alignment with visual contact, and accurate actions. To this end, we present VeriTouch, a framework for generating and verifying synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories for policy learning. Conditioned on initial images and task instructions, our world model, VeriGen, jointly generates high-fidelity dual-view videos and realistic tactile sequences over complete manipulation trajectories. By integrating a dedicated tactile expert with a pretrained video model, it captures realistic visual details and tactile deformation dynamics through joint visuo-tactile modeling. translated_title: VeriTouch：经验证的视觉-触觉世界模型，助力提升机器人策略学习
translated_abstract: 扩展视觉-触觉策略学习受到真实世界数据采集成本高昂以及构建逼真仿真环境困难的制约。生成模型为训练数据提供了可扩展的来源，然而有效的演示需要合理的触觉反馈、与视觉接触在时间上的对齐以及准确的动作。为此，我们提出了VeriTouch，一个用于生成并验证合成视觉-触觉轨迹以支持策略学习的框架。以初始图像和任务指令为条件，我们的世界模型VeriGen能够在完整的操作轨迹上联合生成高保真的双视角视频和逼真的触觉序列。通过将专门的触觉专家模块与预训练视频模型相结合，VeriGen借助联合的视觉-触觉建模，捕捉真实的视觉细节和触觉形变动态。随后，我们的多模态验证器VeriEval在检查视觉质量的同时，重点评估触觉可靠性……
tldr: VeriTouch框架通过世界模型VeriGen联合生成高保真双视角视频与逼真触觉序列，并利用多模态验证器VeriEval检验合成视觉-触觉轨迹的可靠性，从而改进机器人策略学习的数据扩展问题。
en_tdlr: VeriTouch is a framework that generates high-fidelity dual-view videos and realistic tactile sequences with a joint visuo-tactile world model, and verifies their reliability via a multimodal verifier to improve robot policy learning.
